FAQ

  • Changes to currencies will be updated upon your next billing and reflected in your following billing statement. Any price differences are calculated and displayed during checkout if you upgrade or downgrade.
  • When pledging to a creator who operates and sets prices in a currency other than your preferred currency, Patreon converts the tier price for you using a conversion based on historical exchange rate data. You can learn more about how we calculate the exchange rate here: How tiers are converted into other currencies.
  • Credit and debit card transactions on Patreon are currently accepted in our supported currencies. If you’re viewing the site in one of these supported checkout currencies, the entire checkout process will be in that currency. Otherwise, the currency displayed will be the creator’s currency.
  • Similarly, if you pay through PayPal and you’re viewing the site in one of these supported checkout currencies, the entire checkout process will be in that currency. Otherwise, the currency displayed will be the creator’s currency.

Navigate the Patreon app as a member

If you’re also a creator on Patreon, visit our guide on Navigate the Patreon app as a creator.

Patreon is where you can access exclusive podcasts, videos, art, writing, recipes, courses, music, and more from your favorite creators, and build community with both the creators you love and other fans.

To get started, download the latest version of the Patreon app for your device:

  • Patreon app for iOS
  • Patreon app for Android

The app has a bottom menu with tabs to help you navigate. The sections below explain what each tab does and how to use it.

  • When you log in, you’ll arrive at the Home screen. This is where you can browse content from the creators you support and discover new ones.

Your feed

  • The Home screen is split into two tabs:
    • Home: A discovery feed showing posts from creators you don’t yet follow, alongside creators you already support. Posts from creators you’re already a member of are always prioritized
    • Memberships: A feed reserved entirely for posts and Quips from creators you’re already a member of. Use this tab to keep up with your existing memberships without the discovery mix
  • Besides the Home and Memberships feed, there’s a shortcut in the Home tab that lets fans quickly see a list of the creators they support, so they can jump straight to a creator’s page and catch up on their latest posts without scrolling the feed.

Search and discover creators

  • Tap Explore in the top-right corner of the Home screen to search for creators by name or topic and discover new ones. You’ll see personalized suggestions based on your past activity, current memberships, and popular categories.
  • You can swipe left to browse creators within each section or tap the arrows to go through the full list:
    • Search: Type a creator’s name or topic in the search bar to quickly find what you’re looking for or discover something new
    • Topics: At the top of the page, you’ll see taglines related to your interests. Clicking on them takes you to a page featuring top and trending creators in those topics
    • Recently Visited: This section helps you easily return to creators you’ve recently explored. You can also tap More next to their names to remove them from history
    • Creators for you: Find other creators based on your memberships
    • Popular this week: Stay updated on what’s popular. This section highlights creators who are currently trending in the community
    • Explore Topics: Browse through a wide variety of topics and genres. From niche interests to broader categories, this section makes it easy to dive into different types of content that might spark your interest
    • New on Patreon: Discover fresh creators who have recently joined the platform. This section showcases up-and-coming talent, giving you a chance to support and follow new creators early in their journey
    • Top creators: Based on your past activity, memberships, and browsing behavior, this section suggests creators that align with your interests
  • If you’re not interested in a particular creator, simply tap More next to their name and select Not interested to remove them from your suggestions.
  • Members who are 18 years and older can update their settings to view more creators on Patreon, including Adult/18+ creators. To learn more, visit our guide Find creators on Patreon.
  • The Library tab is where you can find all content saved or in progress. You can tap the arrows to go through the full list.
  • The Library is organized into three sections:
    • Recently played: Audio and video posts you’ve been listening to or watching, listed in order of recent activity
    • Recently viewed: Posts you’ve browsed recently
    • Saved posts: Posts you’ve saved for later
  • Tap Your account in the top right corner of the Library tab to manage:
    • Automatic downloads: When enabled, audio and video posts from creators you’re a member of are automatically downloaded to your device for offline listening and viewing
    • Delete finished downloads: Removes audio and video posts from your device once you’ve finished listening to or watching them, helping you manage your storage
    • Video download quality: Adjust the quality level for downloaded videos. A lower quality uses less storage space, while a higher quality provides a better viewing experience
  • The Chats tab is where you can engage with communities that are part of your membership through group chats or send direct messages to creators.

Group chats

- Tap Chats in the bottom menu
- You'll see a list of all the chats you have access to as part of your memberships
- Select a chat you want to join
- If it's your first time joining a creator's community, you'll need to agree to the chat guidelines before joining
- Once you're in, type your message at the bottom of the screen and tap the arrow to send
  • You can customize how fellow members see you by tapping on your profile image after engaging with a message, then tap More and selecting Edit profile.
  • Learn more about how community chats work for members.

Direct messages

  • If you have an active membership with a creator or have purchased one of their products, you can send them a private message.
    • Tap Chats in the bottom menu
    • Tap Direct messages to access your conversations
    • Tap an existing conversation to reply, or tap + in the top right corner to start a new message thread
  • If you’d like to message a creator, visit the guide, How do I message a creator?
  • To manage your push and email notification preferences, tap Notifications from the bottom menu. Once on the Notification screen, select Your account in the top right corner.
  • The Notifications screen is where you can keep up with new posts, messages, and activity from the creators you support. Tap on a notification to view the post, read comments, or join a chat.

Managing Quips notifications

  • To turn off notifications for Quips from creators you don’t yet follow:
    • Tap Your account in the top right corner of the Notification screen
    • Tap Notification settings
    • Unmark the checkbox for Posts and Quips from creators you might like
  • To adjust notifications for a specific creator:
    • From the same screen, scroll down to find the creator in the list and tap on their name
    • Adjust their notification settings individually using the checkboxes
  • Tap Profile to access your profile and account settings. From here, you can:
  • Setting
  • Description
  • Edit your profile
  • Select Edit profile to update your name, photo, and bio. Learn more about what information you share with fellow community members.
  • Likes
  • View all the posts and Quips you’ve liked on Patreon.
  • Settings
    • The email address on your account
    • Notification settings: Manage general and creator-specific notifications. Learn more about notification settings
    • Advanced settings: Toggle auto-play in queue, automatic downloads, and delete finished downloads
    • Full public profile: Toggle on to make your profile public. Learn more about Your public Patreon profile
    • Community profile: Toggle on to activate your community profile. Learn more about what information you share with fellow community members
    • Memberships: A list of all the creators you’re a member of, free and paid
    • Patreon’s Community Guidelines, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy
    • Adult/18+ content settings
    • Delete account
  • Support
  • Access the Help Center, submit a support request, or check your app version.
  • Moderation
  • Check all your reported Messages.
  • Log out
  • Sign out of your Patreon account.

Accessing a creator’s page in the app

Tap on a creator profile in the Home screen to:

  • View and interact with all available posts
  • Access creator-curated Collections
  • Participate in Chats
  • Browse and purchase through the creator’s shop
Managing your membership

To manage your membership with a creator:

  • Tap on a creator’s profile from the Home screen or the shortcut in the top left corner
  • Tap More in the upper right corner
  • Select Your membership
  • Tap Edit membership at the bottom of the screen

From here, you can:

  • Change membership: Select a different membership tier or increase your membership amount
  • Cancel membership: Cancel your membership with that creator. You may still have access for a period of time after canceling. To learn more, visit What happens when I cancel?
  • Edit payment method: Update or add a new payment method. For more details, visit our guide on How do I update my payment information?

If you’re a free member, you’ll see the option to Upgrade or Leave the membership instead.

More options on a creator’s page

Tap More in the top right corner of a creator’s page to access:

  • About: Read the creator’s about section
  • Share: Share the creator’s Patreon
  • Your membership: See details about your membership, or upgrade, edit, or cancel
  • Gift membership: Gift a creator’s paid membership to someone else
  • Add to podcast app: Access a unique RSS feed for audio posts if available with your membership. Learn more about how to use your audio RSS
  • Block this creator: Blocking a creator means they won’t be able to see your comments or messages. Any active membership and future payments will be canceled
  • Report: Report a violation of Patreon’s Community Guidelines

See the table below to check all the additional actions you can take on a creator’s page in the app:

The creator’s Home tab is your default landing spot when you visit their page. It’s a curated view highlighting what matters most, from recent posts to featured collections, livestreams, podcasts, or shop items.

Posts

The Posts tab shows all of the creator’s published posts, ordered by date. Tap on a post to read, watch, or listen, and to view comments.

Quips

The Quips tab shows all of the creator’s Quips. Short, public updates designed for quick engagement. Tap on a Quip to react or leave a comment.

Activity

The Activity tab shows the creator’s recent comments and likes on posts. Use this tab to follow the conversation happening around their content.

Collections

If you’re a member of a creator who has collections, you can tap on the Collections tab to browse through collections of their work or purchase any collections the creator has set for sale.

Chats

From the Chats tab, you can easily access all chats from that creator that are included in your membership.

Shop

If the creator has a shop, you’ll find their digital products and collections for sale here. Tap the Sort button right below the Shop tab to filter and find what you’re looking for. For information about iOS in-app purchase availability in your country, visit our iOS in-app purchases: Country & currency page.

Recommendations

If the creator has chosen to recommend other creators on Patreon, you’ll find them here. Tap on a recommendation to visit their page and subscribe.

Dark mode

Setting your device to dark mode will automatically apply dark mode to the Patreon app on both Android and iOS.

Choose your app icon (iOS)

On the latest version of the Patreon iOS app, you can select a custom app icon. Here’s how:

  • Tap your icon in the bottom menu
  • Tap
  • Tap Edit profile
  • Tap Choose your app icon
  • Browse the selection and tap the one you’d like to use

Watching videos on Android TV App

Patreon is available on Android TV, including TVs and streaming devices that use the Google TV interface. Fans can search for Patreon in the Google Play Store on an Android TV device to install it. We’re continuing to build out the Android TV experience.

What’s available right now
  • Media from memberships, creator pages, collections, and search
  • Watch native video and listen to audio posts, with play, pause, seek, playback speed, captions, and quality selection
What’s not yet available
  • Embedded videos (from platforms like YouTube or Vimeo)
  • Playback queue and autoplay
  • Text and image posts
  • Posts fans don’t have access to won’t appear in the app (there’s currently no way to unlock a post directly from Android TV)

Account settings, publishing and editing posts, and other creator tools are only available in the Patreon app or on desktop, they aren’t part of the Android TV experience.

Niches for members Early Access (Members: Being a member)

Niches are community spaces in the Patreon app built around a shared interest, where fans and creators post together. Each Niche has its own feed of Quips, its own rules, and a community of people who care about the same thing you do. No single creator owns a Niche, so it’s about the interest, not one page.

Niches are in early access and available only in the Patreon app for iOS and Android. We’re starting with a small number of Niches and plan to add more over time.

What you can do in a Niche

Once you join a Niche, you can:

  • Post Quips, short posts with text, images, or short videos
  • Reply to prompts, the questions pinned at the top of a Niche to get conversations going
  • Comment on Quips, including with images
  • Like Quips, requip them with your own comment, or share them with the Niche
  • Invite others with the Niche’s link or QR code

Everyone in a Niche can post, creators and fans alike.

How to join a Niche

Right now, you can join a Niche with an invite link or QR code shared by someone who’s already in it. You’ll need a Patreon account and the Patreon app.

  • Open the invite link or scan the QR code
  • Tap Join community
  • Log in to your Patreon account, or sign up if you don’t have one yet
  • The Niche opens in the Patreon app

If you open an invite link on a computer, scan the QR code with your phone to continue in the app.

How to find your Niches in the app

After you join, your Niches appear in 2 places:

  • At the top of your Home screen
  • In the Niches section of the menu

Tap a Niche to open the community space. The newest Quips appear first, with any pinned prompts at the top. For more on the Home screen, read our guide to navigating the Patreon app as a member.

How to post in a Niche

Before you can post or comment, you’ll need to verify your email address. The first time you post in a Niche, you’ll also be asked to agree to its rules.

  • Open the Niche
  • Tap Create Quip
  • Add your text, images, or short video
  • Choose whether anyone can comment or no one can comment
  • Tap Publish

If it’s your first post in that Niche, read the Niche rules and tap Agree to Niche rules. If you close the rules without agreeing, they’ll appear again the next time you post.

To answer a prompt, open the prompt and post your reply as a Quip. Scheduling and drafts aren’t available for Niche Quips yet.

Where your Niche Quips appear

Quips you post in a Niche appear in that Niche’s feed. They can also show up in the Home feed of other people in the same Niche. Quips from Niches you’re in can appear in your Home feed too.

If you’re a creator, the Quips you post in a Niche also appear in the Quips tab of your Patreon page.

How Niche rules work

Each Niche has its own rules, written by its founding creators and fans with Patreon. They cover things specific to that Niche, like spoilers or self-promotion. You’ll find them in the Niche’s details.

Niche rules are different from Patreon’s Community Guidelines:

  • Niche rules apply only inside that Niche. During early access, the Patreon Community team reviews reports about them
  • Community Guidelines apply everywhere on Patreon, including Niches. The Trust & Safety team reviews reports about them

How to report or block someone in a Niche

If something in a Niche violates community guidelines or the Niche rules, you can report it:

  • Tap More on the Quip or comment
  • Tap Report
  • Choose a reason. To report something that breaks the Niche’s rules, choose the Niche rules option
  • Tap Submit

Once you report a Quip or comment, it’s hidden from your view right away. You can also report a person’s profile. To learn more, read our article on reporting content that violates Community Guidelines.

You can also block someone. Blocking limits how you and that person can interact, in both directions. Read everything you need to know about blocking another user.

How to leave a Niche

You can leave a Niche at any time.

  • Open the Niche
  • Tap More
  • Tap Leave

After you leave, that Niche’s Quips stop appearing in your Home feed. You can rejoin later with an invite link.

If you were added to the Niche automatically, we won’t add you back to it again, even if you join another creator who’s part of it.

FAQ

Is it free to join a Niche?

Yes. Being in a Niche is free and separate from your memberships. Nothing about what you pay or what you get from a creator changes.

Do I need to be a member of a creator to join a Niche?

No. Anyone with a Patreon account can join a Niche with an invite link, whether or not they’re a member of the creators in it.

Why was I added to a Niche?

If you’re a free or paid member of a creator who’s part of a Niche, you may be added to that Niche automatically. The next time you open the Patreon app, you’ll see a welcome screen that explains why you were added. Being in a Niche is free and doesn’t change your membership, what you pay, or what you get from the creator. If you’d rather not be in the Niche, you can leave at any time.

Can I use Niches on desktop?

Not yet. Niches are available only in the Patreon app for iOS and Android. Invite links open in any browser, but you’ll need the app to join and post.

How do I find more Niches?

There isn’t a way to browse or search for Niches yet. For now, you can join with an invite link from someone who’s already in a Niche.

Can I create my own Niche?

Not yet. Right now, Patreon creates Niches with a small group of founding creators and fans. If there’s a Niche you’d like to see, suggest a new Niche.

Can I invite other people to a Niche?

Yes. Share the Niche’s invite link or QR code. There is a share icon at the top right of the Niche. Invite links don’t expire, and anyone with a Patreon account can use them.

Why can’t I post or comment in a Niche?

Make sure you’ve verified your email address and agreed to the Niche’s rules. If you still can’t post, the Niche may be temporarily paused for new Quips. You can still comment while a Niche is paused. Additionally, if you have a creator page, your page must be published in order to post.

Are Niches available in my language?

Not yet. Niches are available in English for now.

I’m a fan on Android and unable to participate in a Niche. Why?

If you have a creator page you started and never published, you’ll need to publish it to fully participate in a Niche on Android. This can happen if you accidentally started a creator page.

Redeeming a membership discount

We are currently testing a feature that allows creators to offer a discount for the first month or first year of a fan’s membership. You can redeem a discount code if you don’t have an active paid membership with the creator. This article explains how to redeem a discount

Information about redeeming a membership discount

There are two ways you can redeem a discount to a creator’s Patreon membership. You can do it by adding a discount code during checkout or by taking advantage of a public sale that the creator is running.

At this time, discounts can only be redeemed by fans who aren’t already in an active paid membership with the creator. Discounts apply only to the first billing period: the first month if you choose a monthly subscription or the first year if you select an annual subscription.

How to redeem a membership discount

If you have multiple discount codes, they do not stack. You will need to choose which offer you want to take advantage of.

If you’re using the mobile app, public sales won’t be visible on the membership tiers. However, both public sales and discount codes can still be applied during checkout, which will open in a browser window within the app.

Taking advantage of a public sale:
  • Head to the creator’s membership page.
  • If a creator is running a publicly displayed sale, the original price of their membership will be crossed out in place of a new monthly price
  • Press Join on the tier you’re interested in joining
  • This will take you to the checkout page, where the discount is already applied
  • Fill out your payment information and complete the checkout process
  • Once completed, you will receive your first month or year of membership at the discounted rate
  • Every month or year thereafter will be full price unless specified otherwise
Taking advantage of a discount code:
  • Head to the creator’s membership page
  • The creator may only choose specific tiers to discount. They should specify this when sharing the code
  • Choose the tier that is discounted
  • Add the discount code (e.g. SUMMER15) under the Discount code section
  • Fill out your payment information and complete the checkout process
  • Once completed, you will receive your first month or year of membership at the discounted rate
  • Every month or year thereafter will be full price unless specified otherwise

Public sale terms & conditions

Discounts apply only to the first month of new, automatically-renewing monthly paid subscriptions or the first year of new, automatically-renewing annual paid subscriptions, and to select tiers, as specified on the creator page

Not applicable to existing automatically-renewing subscriptions, including upgrades or downgrades of existing automatically-renewing subscriptions, or subscriptions canceled and reactivated during the promotion period. Cannot be combined with other offers or discounts. Offer available until the date listed on the creator’s page.

FAQs

  • Discounts can only be redeemed by people who aren’t active members of the creator’s community. This includes new fans, free members, and anyone not receiving any paid member benefits from the creator.
  • Discounts will either be for the first month or the first year of your membership. This will be specified upon checkout. Once your membership is renewed, you will be charged the full monthly or annual price of the membership.
  • You can only redeem the same discount code once per creator.
  • Creators can choose how long the code or public sale is available. This information will be communicated either when sharing the code or displayed directly on the membership page during public sales.
  • Yes, if you have a discount code from the creator, you can add it to the discount code section during checkout. Your inputted discount code will take into effect, and override the automatic code.

Starting a Free Trial

How it works

If your creator offers free trials on their page, you are able to explore a creator’s membership benefits for a 7-day trial period without being charged. During this time, you can enjoy the perks and exclusive content a creator offers before deciding to continue as a paid member.

Free trials are available to members who have not previously subscribed to a particular creator. Each account and form of payment is eligible for one free trial per creator. If you are a former member of a creator, you will not have the option to start a free trial.

How do I sign up

When a creator offers free trials, instead of Join now you will see a button that says Start free trial on the tiers where the trial is available. Please keep in mind that not all creators offer free trials, and it may vary from tier to tier.

Once you click on Start free trial, you’ll be directed to a page where you’ll need to provide your payment information. You won’t be charged anything until the trial period ends.

After signing up, you’ll receive a confirmation and a welcome email and will immediately gain access to all the benefits offered in that tier, including previous posts.

You can check the status of your memberships by going to your Settings and clicking on the Memberships link from the menu bar. Memberships that are in a free trial period will be indicated as such. Additionally, you will be able to view important details, such as the duration of the free trial and when it is set to expire.

FAQ

  • Free trials are available for a 7-day period. During this time, you’ll have access to the creator’s content for that tier.
  • You will receive all benefits offered in the chosen tier as a paying member would, with the exception of receiving merch rewards. If you are on a tier that offers Merch, you will not start earning toward merch rewards until your first payment.
  • For Discord, you will be granted appropriate roles for access based on tier eligibility. If you cancel, you will have your roles removed accordingly.
  • All free trials turn into monthly subscriptions at the end of the trial period. If you wish to become an annual member, you will need to edit your membership in your Active memberships tab.
  • You will be charged at the end of your 7-day free trial period unless you cancel before that period ends. For instance, let’s say you start a free trial on May 22nd. If you do not cancel your trial before May 29th, your payment method will be charged for the selected tier’s membership fee.
  • You will still have access to your benefits through the end of your trial period.
  • Once the free trial period ends, your payment method will be charged for the selected tier’s membership price unless you cancel your pledge before the trial concludes.
  • Your creator will be able to have insights to know when you started and when you canceled your free trial. Contact your creator to verify this information, or you can reach Support by scrolling down to the bottom of this article and clicking the Email Patreon Support button.
  • We recently rolled out Apple’s in-app purchasing requirements to Patreon’s iOS mobile app, which currently does not support free trials on this system. We are working to support free trials in the iOS app as a fast follow. Free trials are currently available to fans on web, mobile web, and Android.
